title: DON'T Play RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0.1 Until You Know THIS!
author: BiggySweats
chapters: Dragonwilds 1.0.1 — What You Need to Know
Your Equipment Has Changed — Ring Slots & Glory Nerf
Death From Above — How It Works
Raid Skips, Kuldra & Ascension Core Fixes
description:
RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0.1 has changed quite a few things, and if you're jumping back into the game, some of your old equipment choices and combat setups might need another look.

This update brings new Ranged special attacks, separate Ring and Amulet slots, an Amulet of Glory nerf, stronger Rune ammunition, Death From Above, 8 extra inventory slots, improved quest tracking, enemy aggression changes, farming upgrades, raid fixes and important save recovery improvements.

If you've been playing Dragonwilds since 1.0, these are the biggest changes worth knowing before you jump back in, including what I'd check first, which upgrades actually matter and some reported issues to watch out for.
